articles.title: ACL Recovery Timelines: Separating the Myths From the Data
articles.author: Adi
articles.content:
This article is being written. Here's what it will cover:

What the Research Actually Says

  • NFL WR return-to-play rate post-ACL: 60–69% (compared to 79% for RBs)
  • Average return timeline: 10.9–13.6 months — not the "9-month miracle" narratives suggest
  • Career length shortened by ~1.9 seasons vs. matched controls
  • ~25% subsequent ACL injury risk (either knee) within 2-3 years

Case Studies

  • Malik Nabers (2025) — ACL + meniscus combined tear, scar tissue complications
  • Odell Beckham Jr. — the cautionary tale of rushing return
  • Cooper Kupp — the success story of patient rehabilitation

The Fantasy Angle

  • How to price ACL-recovering WRs in dynasty
  • The "Year 2 bounce" — does it actually exist?
  • Historical ADP discount vs. actual production post-ACL
